name: 54411 · Athens, WI
findings: ZIP 54411 (Athens) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54411 (Athens) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54411 (Athens) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
